  "key_insight": "Tool parameters with enum constraints must be strictly respected; descriptive elaborations should be decomposed into valid enum values rather than passed as custom strings. This is a scenario-specific constraint enforcement issue where the model prioritized semantic fidelity over schema compliance."
}
